notes_for_editor: Only one tower-specific source (Tennessee Landforms) exists for Pigeon Roost. It gives the coordinates, elevation, number 6-21 and standing status. The record lists an NGS register entry (GC 2610); the towers page shows GC2610 only as a code in its Info column, with no register name, so the register label is unverified. No build date, design, height, staffing, access or fire history was found. The 2014 National Register form omits Pigeon Roost, so standing status is disputed. Other towers named Pigeon Roost (WV, AR) are different towers and were not used.
